chart.label: contrast 辛 The Jewel, Overfueled, heavy Earth (fixture: Metal 20 / Earth 45 / Wood 15 / Fire 10 / Water 10)

original.friction_turn: Run heavy, the setting closes over the stone: so much preparation that the jewel never leaves the box. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Take it out and wear it somewhere real.

friction.clause: The setting closes over the stone: so much preparation that the jewel never leaves the box.
friction.remedy: Take it out and wear it somewhere real.

thin.clause: Earth runs thin and unwanted: a little shelter, easily left.
thin.remedy: Leave it as it is, small.

excess.clause: Too much earth buries the metal: talent that never surfaces, thought that never becomes a cut.
excess.remedy: Take it out of the box. Cut one thing.

repFields.function.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is a slow, deep intake that turns experience into ground you can stand on. Books, mentors, quiet corners, long walks after hard conversations: whatever feeds it comes back later as judgment.
repFields.function.definition_friction: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch. Study, comfort, preparation, shelter: everything that goes in counts as progress, so nothing ever has to come out. Learning becomes the most respectable way to stand still.
repFields.function.advise_catalyst: Deep minds underrate their own output, so build the habit of releasing some. Once a month, teach one thing you learned to one person, because explaining it is how you find out it is really yours. Keep one notebook instead of six. And say your slow answer out loud before someone faster says a worse one.
repFields.function.advise_friction: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.
repFields.mechanism.base: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any edge is struck from it, and every blade remembers the patience of the rock that made it.
repFields.mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the mountain goes hungry: a keen edge with nothing behind it, sharpness spent faster than it forms. Your chart asks you to feed the ground. Rest and study are smelting, not stalling.
repFields.cta_verdict: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.
repFields.carry.catalyst: The mountain goes hungry: a keen edge with nothing behind it, sharpness spent faster than it forms. Rest and study are smelting, not stalling.
repFields.carry.wide: You are well supplied with Earth, the ground the ore grows in. Use what the ground gave you. Cut something.
repFields.carry.missing: No ground under the edge: judgment made on the spot, nothing settled in first. Borrow ground: a mentor, a book, one slow evening.
repFields.carry.spared: Earth runs absent, and the edge is lighter for it: nothing to bury it, nothing to shelter in. Keep it that way. Decide, then rest.
